name: lane-board
what: Lists the files each git worktree is changing and names every file that two or more lanes touch.

faults.fault: A squash-merged lane keeps counting as editing its files, so finished work reads as an overlap.
Untracked files are left out, so a new file edited in two lanes goes unseen.
A file needs three lanes before it counts as an overlap.
Every changed file is reported as an overlap, even in one lane.
